decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-3bf2a40b8e98] says what was broken and what was fixed: some installation status lines were not finalized correctly, which could make the output render oddly when a terminal window is resized. The fix is that these lines are now finalized. The only effect it describes is on how the terminal output looks, so a typed assertion can record a bugfix to installer status output with no operational consequence. The installation section context [ev-18ac53d77b4b] through [ev-9fb93117372e] does not name the command or binary that prints these lines, so the subject can only be given as "installation status output" and applicability as interactive terminal use of the installer. For a display-only fix, that should not change the class.
